listing:
Super Detailed Winter 2027 Sublet Post — 226 Spruce St, Waterloo, ON ($990/mo)

Hey future roommate! I'm a 4A Mechanical Engineering student heading out to Calgary for my final co-op term, so I'm looking for a friendly, responsible UW or Laurier student to sublet my bedroom at 226 Spruce St, Waterloo, ON from January 1, 2027 to April 30, 2027. I know apartment hunting from afar is stressful, so I'm putting every single detail I can think of right here to save us both twenty back-and-forth messages!

THE ROOM & FURNITURE: It's the biggest bedroom in our 3-bedroom second-floor unit (approx. 11x13 ft) with two south-facing windows that get tons of natural light even during grey February afternoons. I'm leaving my queen bed with a fresh mattress protector, a wide IKEA desk, an ergonomic mesh office chair, a 3-drawer dresser, a floor lamp, and a mini bookshelf. There's a full built-in closet with hangers and extra storage bins underneath the bed. The bedroom door has its own deadbolt key for privacy.

THE APARTMENT & ROOMMATES: You'll be sharing the kitchen, living room, and 1.5 bathrooms with two awesome third-year UW students (one in Math/CPA and one in Nanotechnology Engineering). Both are quiet during the week, keep the kitchen counters wiped down, and usually cook simple dinners around 6:30pm. The kitchen has a full-size fridge, oven, microwave, air fryer, rice cooker, and dishwasher that we're happy to share. Living room has a big sectional couch and a 55-inch TV with HDMI cables ready for movie nights. In-building card-operated laundry is right downstairs on the ground floor ($2.50 wash / $2.25 dry) and rarely busy on weekday mornings. Our landlord lives out in Burlington (not in the building), is responsive over email, and already signed our written sublet consent.

LOCATION & COMMUTE: 226 Spruce St is right between King and Hickory—about an 11-minute walk to E7/DC, or a 4-minute walk to the GRT 7/12/202 stops and University Ave Plaza. Getting to an 8:30am lecture on UW campus is super easy even when sidewalks are snowy. Groceries are convenient too: Sobeys on Columbia is a short bus ride, and the Plaza has tons of late-night food spots plus Farah Foods for quick produce runs.

RENT, UTILITIES & PAPERWORK: Monthly rent is $990, which covers heat, water, hydro, central air, and fast 500 Mbps fibre Wi-Fi (usually clocks 420+ Mbps on Wi-Fi in the bedroom for Zoom calls). We'll sign the Ontario Standard Lease sublet addendum after you check out the place. Just one quick detail from the landlord's student addendum: when you put down the last month's rent deposit, the landlord specifies that no annual interest is paid on the deposit and it is strictly non-refundable if your co-op plans change.

VIEWINGS & CONTACT: I'm in Waterloo until December 19 and would love to show you the apartment in person—weekday afternoons or weekends both work well, or we can hop on a live Google Meet walkthrough if you're currently on co-op in another city. Email spruce226.w27@example.com with a quick intro about yourself and a couple of times that work to tour!
label_rationale: Needle-in-a-haystack long-context listing (~520 words): mostly clean, genuine Waterloo sublet with off-site landlord, written sublet consent (RTA s. 97), Ontario Standard Lease (s. 12.1), and in-person/video tours offered, EXCEPT one void/questionable clause buried in paragraph 5 stating that 'no annual interest is paid on the deposit and it is strictly non-refundable if your co-op plans change'. This conflicts with Ontario RTA s. 106(6) (landlord must pay annual interest on the rent deposit at the guideline rate) and s. 106(10) (rent deposit applies strictly to last rent period; void under s. 4(1)). Under SPEC D6, HOLD.
